recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-32751 for the current build by aligning the remaining checked-in ModelInfo surface with the published R5 StructureDefinition change; future ModelInfo regeneration should preserve these canonical datatypes.
issue_request: FHIR-32751 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the CDS work group. It requested changing the ActivityDefinition reference to ObservationDefinition to canonical, and the final resolution also required specimenRequirement, observationRequirement, and observationResultRequirement to be canonical, including the SpecimenDefinition reference.
initial_application: PR #2237 applied the main source change for R5: commit 027786fb6f8598c84ab06411f07cc49739ecaa6c changed the three ActivityDefinition StructureDefinition element types from Reference to canonical, and merge commit 7e44ec168d3c0b2bbf85e343e0eadff65bfcea4a brought that work into the main branch. The current ActivityDefinition StructureDefinition and diagram already show canonical.
additional_context: ActivityDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and the Library resource examples include the checked-in FHIR ModelInfo XML through list-Library-examples.xml and library-examples-header.xml. That ModelInfo source still exposed the same ActivityDefinition properties as FHIR.Reference. Targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later final decision reversing the canonical change; a separate Triaged DataRequirement issue was not in scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement, ActivityDefinition.observationRequirement, and ActivityDefinition.observationResultRequirement are lists of FHIR.canonical instead of FHIR.Reference. No authoritative ActivityDefinition StructureDefinition edit was needed because it was already correct.
